newsitem.title: CHINA: China issues new rules for T-bill spot trading.
newsitem.headline: China issues new rules for T-bill spot trading.

text.p: China has issued new rules for state debt trading that allow holders of treasury bonds to trade on any debt exchange in the country, the Shanghai Securities News said on Saturday.
Previously, debt purchased in Shanghai, Shenzhen and Wuhan, the three main debt trading centres, could only be traded in the exchange where they were purchased.
Regulations issued earlier this year require all owners of government debt to place the debt ownership certificates with the China Government Securities Depository Trust and Clearing Co.
The company is being set up in Beijing to coordinate all debt trading.
The newspaper said the depository would issue a receipt for the bonds which could then be traded on any authorised exchange in China.
